With the skills system dropping soon, I’m both excited and a little anxious-TDS has always been a wild ride when it comes to balance. In fact, this may or may not be for a future project...👀 Without further ado, let's get into it! Remember that old, low-res “perks” teaser BelowNautural posted years ago? It looked super cool and totally fit the TDS vibe back then-small effects that could seriously impact your game. But then, poof! It disappeared without a trace. What a shame. Even if perks came back, they’d probably be either way too broken or totally useless in today’s TDS meta. So, let’s take inspiration from “Critical Tower Defense,” where perks always come with a catch.
